name: Special Request: In the Web of Corruption
source: The game is about a successful woman that gets involved in somebodies’ game behind her back. The story will lead to the discovery of some secrets in a City, and the once sunny environment will show its dark side now. The main protagonist will have to endure blackmail and corruption, and there will be other fetishes to meet as well. Will she be able to fight her life back again?​
translation: 该游戏讲述了一位成功的女性在背后参与他人的游戏的故事。故事将导致一座城市中一些秘密的发现，曾经阳光明媚的环境现在将展现出其黑暗的一面。主角将不得不忍受勒索和腐败，并且还会遇到其他恋物癖。她能再次战胜自己的生活吗？​
